meta.name: pathfinder
meta.description: Map a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, identify duplicated concerns across features, and propose a unified architecture. Use when asked to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. Emits a proposed unified flowchart plus per-system /make-plan prompts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将代码库映射为功能流程图，识别重复并统一架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构或统一多个重复系统
copy.tagline_en: Map codebase into feature flowcharts, identify duplicates, and unify architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring or unifying duplicated systems

howto.what: Claude 会分析代码库（不直接写实现代码）：先按功能分块，为每个功能绘制标注了 file:line 的 Mermaid 流程图；找出跨功能的重复点，提出最简统一架构，并把 /make-plan 提示交给后续步骤；产出放在 PATHFINDER-日期 目录。
howto.when: 当用户说「find the ideal path」、要求统一重复系统，或要在重构前审查架构时触发。

say.text: 用 pathfinder 帮我统一代码库里重复的系统。
say.note: 会运行分阶段分析，产出重复报告与统一提案。

say.text: 重构前先审查架构，标出可以合并的模块。
say.note: 会从功能发现开始，再画各功能流程图。

say.text: find the ideal path，把搜索和筛选流程合并。
say.note: 触发技能找出重复点，生成统一流程图。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude maps the codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, finds duplicated concerns, proposes the simplest unified design, and hands per-system /make-plan prompts to later steps—all without writing implementation code. Outputs land in a PATHFINDER-<date> folder.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to 'find the ideal path,' unify duplicated systems, or audit the architecture before a refactor.

say_en.text: Use pathfinder to unify the duplicated systems in this codebase.
say_en.note: Runs the phased analysis; produces a duplication report and proposal.

say_en.text: Audit the architecture before refactoring and show what can be merged.
say_en.note: Starts with feature discovery, then per-feature flowcharts.

say_en.text: find the ideal path and unify search and filtering.
say_en.note: Finds duplicate concerns and generates a unified flowchart.
